items.scenario: This is a small supplier and you have bigger payments to worry about this month. You are not planning to pay them yet. They have messaged you again. You have only recently started buying from them.
items.reply: abhi bade payments priority pe hain, iska payment thoda baad me karenge

items.scenario: You have received a formal-sounding notice from this supplier mentioning legal provisions about delayed payment to small enterprises.
items.reply: notice mil gaya hai. internally check kar raha hu, concerned person se baat karke revert karta hu

items.scenario: Business has been very slow for several months and you honestly do not have the cash right now. The supplier is asking for payment. You have a long-standing relationship with this supplier.
items.reply: business kaafi slow chal raha hai aur honestly abhi cash available nahi hai. thoda time chahiye

items.scenario: The quality of this batch was not up to standard and your production team has complained. You have not paid. The supplier has messaged. The supplier has messaged you once before about this.
items.reply: quality issue ke wajah se payment roka hua hai. production team ne batch approve nahi kiya

items.scenario: Your owner signs off on all payments above a certain amount and he is travelling until next week. The supplier wants to know when it will be released.
items.reply: owner approval pending hai aur woh next week tak travel pe hain. uske baad release hoga

items.scenario: Your own customers owe you a lot of money and have not paid, so you cannot pay your suppliers either. The supplier is following up. This is the first time they have contacted you about it.
items.reply: customers ke payments kaafi pending hain, uski wajah se cash flow tight hai. collection aate hi clear karenge

items.scenario: You paid this bill a few days ago by bank transfer. The supplier seems not to have noticed and is asking again. The supplier has messaged you once before about this.
items.reply: payment already kar diya tha bank transfer se few days back. please check once

items.scenario: You could manage the payment if you were allowed to split it over a few months, but not in one go. The supplier is asking for the whole amount. The supplier has messaged you once before about this.
items.reply: ek saath pura amount arrange nahi hoga. monthly instalments me kar sakte hain kya
